# === Import Directives ===

--8<-- [start:import_from]
-import_from(utils, [Double, Helper])
--8<-- [end:import_from]

--8<-- [start:import_from_ex2]
-import_from(utils, [alias(Double, MyDouble)])
--8<-- [end:import_from_ex2]

--8<-- [start:import_module]
-import_module(utils)
--8<-- [end:import_module]


# === Predicate Property Directives ===

--8<-- [start:meta_predicate]
-meta_predicate(my_map(2, +, -))
--8<-- [end:meta_predicate]


# === Specialization Directive ===

--8<-- [start:specialize]
-specialize(SolveCount, NatnumProgram, alias=SolveCountNatnum)
--8<-- [end:specialize]

--8<-- [start:specialize_ex2]
-specialize(MI, Source, alias=Name, depth=5)     # deep unfolding
-specialize(MI, Source, alias=Name, cpd=True)     # conjunctive partial deduction
--8<-- [end:specialize_ex2]


# === EDCG Directives ===

--8<-- [start:edcg_pred]
-edcg_pred(scaled_inc, 0, [counter, scale])
--8<-- [end:edcg_pred]


# === Atom-identity Directives (GLOBAL_ATOMS_DEFAULT.md) ===

--8<-- [start:module_with_atoms]
-module(traffic, [Phase(X), red, amber, green])
--8<-- [end:module_with_atoms]

--8<-- [start:private_with_atoms]
-private([draft, internal_only])
--8<-- [end:private_with_atoms]

--8<-- [start:strict_atoms]
-strict_atoms
-module(immigration_rules, [Eligible(X), Denied(X, Reason)])
-private([visa_type, application_status])
-import_from(atoms, [ok, error, pending])
--8<-- [end:strict_atoms]

--8<-- [start:hide]
-module(vault, [Check(X)])
-hide([vault_secret])
--8<-- [end:hide]
